parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specify whether to enable the flexible group creation feature. Valid values:

*   **true**: enables the flexible group creation feature.
*   **false**: disabled the flexible group creation feature.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can call the [GetInstanceList](~~437663~~) operation to query instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka enable-auto-group-creation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-mp919o4v0000 --enable true --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
